book.name: Luk
book.title: Luk Gagalo euda Iesu Keriso umanawa Luk girumalena

content: Apana debamau Iesu bosapua intawa banusaio Iudas saumode
Walama sawo Ierusalem bedewe Ius apanawa bured sasanasiawaia odantopue napua walamawa maidalen, oda sa ebowa da waia Pasowa.

Pirisi debamau ita anaana waeuwalala oda sa bedewe mai Iesu wadape kotu osowe itupe bosapona rua, dia. Mo apana uara sape auweiena Iesu adiwentopue mo amboitumopua sawanton. Sa baiwa mo inta banusaie Iesu weregainta wadapona baiwa.
Mo inta banusaio bedewe Iesu wawe alala 12 bedeuwo sou dea Iudas, me ebowa da waia Iskariot, bedewe Seitan oden.
Tauma Seitan me banleno pirisi debamau ita God duwa onionia apanawa debamau mampo alen ambi me laga mampe Iesu dabuasapie mo mampo nanalepia gagalowantoie.
Mo me saumopia gagalowa etane nuau euleno Iudas sauasaiena mane wanapu.
Mo me mane wanapua umanawa etene me oalene aupe walama itupidewae apana uara oda awa wimoiena emau mowe Iesu mo mampo nanalepia onioniawaleidie.
Iesu wawe alala Pasowa nanawa imaasai

Bured sasanasiawaia odantoie naia walamawa bumpe Iuswa dewau rua sipsip bomoi Pasowa odawa nanawa napua baiwa. Oda ema walamawa wisena baiwa Iesu Pita Ion nata waaubamodie diamone wanase, “Aitane Pasowa nanawa nataa baiwa imaasana.”
Mo Iesu sipoasane waienase, “Naepe e meneedia no ane nana imaasata?”
Iesu sipoamone wanase, “E Ierusalemwa odonune apana dea esa dugiwa awanedia donlepi, me do aitane du dainea me odompo wawe odane aitane
du sa apanawaida donsane diane wanase: No Debamamba e dieedi wadiase: E duawo nana bolawa naepe winede, ne wanawo alala do wante Pasowa nanawa nata?
Ita du apanawa bola debamawa du pouweido imaasaieno winedia euwalepio ewane, sape oda nanawa imaamonatuwapi.”
Pita Ion nata epe diadewasamono ene Ierusalemwa antone Iesu dima uduudu umanawa wamona segantonatuwaieno eweiena. Sape mo Pasowa odawa nanawa laulantone imaamone teiena.
Iesu saua sanaa sauamode
Pasowa nanawa napua walamawa wiseno Iesu me aposeliwa do wimone aisintone waimoiena.
Sape Iesu mo diamone wanase, “Tauma ne nuana uduudu mampe menanedia e do awodea Pasowa nanawa ema nata, muriwa ne pokaida etapa.
Ne e do nana ema nataa menaidanedia, ipawa ne dialedina ne mai Pasowa nanawa da ando napa, dia. Tane Pasowa nanawa ipawaida God gonaawa bedewe ipawanalempaa walamawe ne osowe napa.”
Nana naio bedewe Iesu redu wadene God auwasane ita aposel diamone wanase, “E deadea wain reduwa ema wadane nano alepi.
Tane ne dialedina, ema aupe ne mai wain napa ideita God gonaawa wisepie ipawanalepio tauma ne osowe napa.”
Tauma me bured wadene God auwasane ainpundene ita mo wanamone wanase, “Ema ipa ne etena amonaleide e baila, ema nanune ne insaneanuna.”
Mo nana naieno dialeno Iesu bauta bured wadene amonalena rua deawaa redu wadene wanase, “Redu ema ipa God sauawa sanaa ne osinana e baila memenaubena mampe ipawanaleide.
Tauma ewana, apana mida ne dabuanepie nanalepia me ne nata mape wainite nana naitana.
Apana Otopa ideita bo bedewe alepi God insaisawa rua. Tane me mida Apana Otopa dabuasapie laga mampe kotu apanawa mamposapia me matangela rebarebaida donsapie poka etepi!”
Iesu epe wano mo etane memesantone eda waitarantone waienase, “Mida no bedembo epe dewalepi?”
Mida debamalepia menasampaa gagalowa
Tane do wawe alala bedeuwo mida debamalepona insaisawa segaleno badowa wawadiadiantoie waiase, “Mida no Tatamba wawe alala bedembo debamawaida?”

Iesu mo dima gagalowantoia etene diamone wanase, “Bola daitada warereu mo apanau kasawoga mampe oniamoio ruauntoie waimoi, ita mida uwa daitada apanawa osouwo gabeman mukawa wadeia muba ebou ituposisaie waiase, ‘No ipa apana saulala wainitana.’

Tane e ne wanawo alala mai epe dewaitana! Mida e bedelawo debamalepia menasampa me ituaisilepie oto ompa ruawalepi. Ita mida uwalala apanawa segalepia menasampa me ideita nola dewalala apanawa ruawalepie sosowa simbiamopi.

Eueuwa ema wapo insena: Mida apana debama? Me mida nana onionialeidi wandia, ba me mida simbialeidia? Dauwa mida nana nadie wandia, me ipa debamawaida! Tane ne mai tawo ema apanawa ruau, ne ipa e Tatala debamawaida, tane ne ipa sa e simbialedina!
Tane e ipa sa poka badowaida ne tauma donsadina bedewe ne do wankasantitana, mai eneipona, dia.
Ne Mamana mukana nena gonaana bedewe warerenteapaa baiwa. Ne Mamana warerenteapaa mukawa nena rua deawaa ne muka enaledina
ne gonaana bedewe warereitano ne do wante oda nanawa nata. Tane do ne e sonabaledine muka enaledina ando kolaiwata osowe waine Israel damba 12 kotumona.”
Iesu Pita mampe gagaloleide

Iesu Pita diene wanase, “Saimon, Saimon, ne asisunea! Seitan muka wadena e uduudu wadaetalepie sabamolepi mida e bedelawo badowa enepia rua, irai apanawa wit ipawa empuiamodie kadiu ita eubu nambenambemodia rua.
Tane Saimon, ne e baia rauparinten e sumanaia mai oauaralepie dialepi. Tane e wadaeta ema aupe e insaisaa leusae mainawo dodomanaitee e sosoa sumanai bedewe saumoe wabadomoa.”
Pita aia ema etene sipoasane wanase, “Tatamba, ne mai poka da donsapaa ingugurawantipe wainipona, tane ne ide rua os e nata ane dibura bedewe ita bontata!”
Tauma Iesu leusane wanase, “Pita, ne dieedina ande tadinawa e ne wakoana wae lagaitaa walama natadea, muriwa kanka aiawa wapi.”
Iesu wawe alala dima segalepia baiwaleidia diaimaamode

Tane Iesu wawe alala diamone wanase, “Ne e waaubaleno nola awa aitena walamawe e mai mane lomawa, petala ba sendorola otamope do aitapona, dia. E aitile intasino nitu da osowe wampona abolawaiten, ba?” Mo sipoasane waienase, “Tatamba, no mai dima da abolawantepona, dia.”

Ita Iesu diamone wanase, “Tane tauma walamawe mida mampe mane lomawa ba peta winompa me otamopie do alepi. Ita do mida ona isimawa mampe mai wineipona, me ideita garawa onapea gimaralepie mane wadepie tauma isima gimaralepie mampesapi.

Ne epe dialedina ipawa buka bedewe girumalena wadi wadiase, ‘Mo me umanawa waie waia me ipa witakadilala sou dea.’ Tane gagalo sa ipawa ne umanana wade ita dima girumalena tauma ulaipa sabamoleide ne mainawo.”
Tane wawe alala waienase, “Tatamba ewaa, ona isimawa nata ema winei, no e baia onantataa rua!” Tane Iesu sipoamone wanase, “Ide, ena!”
Iesu wadi Olib osowe rauparileide
Iesu Ierusalem ene wadi Olib osowe odene alen me dewawa rua. Tane wawe alala me warorosane antoiena.
Mo wadi Olib osowe Iesu aleidiawo wimono me diamone wanase, “Rauparitonuna, e rubu ema iedia bedewe omena sawa!”
Iesu mo emone eseanama alene, apana seu aubeio enediitudedia rua, sape me imimpa emmisilene rauparilene wanase,
“Mako, naita e meneempa, e poka etaetala reduwa ne mainawo wadee nambesawo mai napa. Tane mai ne insaisana rua dewasaa, e eba insaisaaida rua segalepi ne mainawo.”
Me epe rauparileidio ensel dea uboe Iesu mampe segalene sausane muka wanen.
Iesu nuawa bedewe poka me bosapia rua dauwa etedie do osowe badowaida rauparileidio pola ampe osina rua dogo osowe nosen.
Me raupari diasane enenwisene leulene alen wawe alala mampo wisene mo nuapare nopemone dewamono intuntoio dommone
diamone wanase, “Ambi ipa epe e ituitilana? Enane rauparitana, rubu nanlanepe iedia bedewe omena sawa.”
Mo Iesu kotu baiwa wadapua baiwantoi
Iesu gagalo andomana diasapona apana ebowa Iudas, me ipa wawe alala 12 sou dea, apana uara uwau taune banlamone Iesu mampe wimoiena. Iudas Iesu mampeleidie me isuruasapia baiwa,
tane Iesu me diene wanase, “Iudas, e Apana Otopa isurua mampe dabuasae ona apanawa mampo nanaitaa baiwaitiana, ba?”
Iesu wawe alala dima segalepia baiwaleidio eweie me diane waienase, “Tatamba, rua ba dia, no isimamba otawiamote mampe onantata?”
Tane wawe alala bedeuwo sou dea pirisi debama nolawa dewalala apanawa epene asiwa on tonpunden.
Iesu dima segalena ewene sipoalene wanase, “Dewa ema ena!” Ita Iesu apana sa asiwa osowe witapa itune inasan.

Ema aupe pirisi debamau, God duwa onionia apanawa ita apana eiau Iesu baiwantone wimoieno me waitaramone wanase, “E isimala ita koinala do otamole ne mainawo wilen, ewaewawa abo ne witakadilala apanawa dea!
Ne walama ruawantedine God duwa bedewe e do wainite ita e mai wadaneapona. Tane tauma e walamalaida wisen, omo ema bedewe duba mukawa nolalepia walamawa.”
Pita Iesu wakoasadie lagawa wade
Tauma mo Iesu wadanaitue banlene pirisi ionoidoa duwe antoiena, tane Pita awoa Iesu wawe aleidie.
Mo kotu duwa enedia bolawa bedewe wimone ia denantone ewamodio Pita wisene mo do sape waimoie.
Tane nola dewalala iwa dea ia sapa bedewe Pita wandio ewendewae wanase, “Apana ema Iesu sowa dea, me do bauta waimoie laie!”
Tane Pita lagalene i sa diene wanase, “Apana e umanawa waiana, ne mai ateina, dia!”
Ema aupeaupe apana da Pita sape wandio ewene wanase, “E ipa apana ema tauma kotuleidia wawe alala sou dea!” Tane Pita me aiawa sipoasane wanase, “Sona, ne mai apana ema wawe alala sou dea, dia!”
Omo dea rua dialeidio apana da waidasane wanase, “Ulaipa, ne ewedine atenten apana ema ipa Iesu do laia, ipawa me Galili apanawa, mo aiauwo gagaloleidio no etate atenten!”
Tane Pita sipoasane wanase, “Sona, ne mai atenteapona e dima umanawa waiana!” Pita gagaloleidioma tauwadea os kanka aiawa wan.
Tauma Tatamba Iesu leulene dodomana Pita ewen. Tane Pita Tatamba gagalowa wana insaidasan, ipawa Iesu bauta Pita diene wanase, “E walama natadea ne wakoana wae lagaitaa, muriwa kanka aiawa wapi.”
Pita Iesu aiawa bauta wana insendewalene nosene peloo alene nuawa pareidaleno ke debama wan.
Tauma iwu apanawa uwaantone Iesu wasisaie epeie.
Mo wasisaie bedewe me emawa taunabodae diane waienase, “Naita e perowetaewo e ateitape dianepona mida e epeede!”
Ita do mo wasi kadiwa uara daitada mampe Iesu dieiena.
Iesu apana eiau danauwo kotuleide
Walama pumpu apana eiau, pirisi debamau ita anaana waeuwalala gagalo baiwa auweieno Iesu banlene mo danauwo wimoiena.
Mo wane waienase, “Naita e Keriso God sauawalena, tauma no dodomana dianea!” Tane Iesu mo diamone wanase, “Ne dialeipono e mai sumanaitapona, dia,
tane ne e waitaraleipono e mai sipoaneapona, dia.
Tane ande ita ando Apana Otopa God mukawaa witapa on deneuwe wampi.”
Mape mo uduudu amboitusane waienase, “E epe wailana, sa ipa e God Otopa?” Iesu sipoamone wanase, “E dima wailana, sa ipa sa!”
Iesu epe sipoamono etane wane waienase, “Dima baiwa benemasiki gagalowa da baiwantitana. No nuba me moawe God wakadisasano etatana!”
